text: Saw a photo I took of a woman wearing a barrette with horses on it, and thought of the horses jumping out. Made this animation.
alt: A barrette with horses running across it; the horses leap out and gallop over the woman’s hair.

text: A watch that came to me in a dream: a thin leather strap, and a flap over a small peephole. Lift it, look through, and that’s how you read the time.
Brass and glass: a hanging mobile of wire, brass, oak and blown glass. It sways with your phone and rings when the pieces touch.
Apartment: a little building for me and a few close friends, where you can see whose light is on.
alt: The Apartment building at night: three floors of windows, two lit.

text: Opened the door: started this page, a running note of what I’m working on.
Rebuilding my site as a map of everything I keep and make.
Working on a hand-made mark for the site, to replace the one that was there.
Steel Angadi: a series on the steel that ran our homes. No. 01 is my school dabba, and you can open it.
alt: A three-tier steel dabba on a wooden school desk.

text: A talking oracle in a glass terrarium globe, with a projector, an iPad and a Tim Burton mood, for Halloween fortune readings.
Tree Walk: a walking app that helps you learn the names of the trees on your street.
A tailor’s order slip with a fabric swatch stapled on, as a web page. Each swatch means something when you hover it.
A first draft of a comedy play, The Tale of Bryan the Bard. Thinking about making it a bit more Indian, and showing it to Pratidhwani.

I help run the lobby for a South Asian theatre group, Pratidhwani. I spent many weekends this fall setting it up so people get the best night at the theatre, and it was extra celebratory because it was around Diwali. I must have said Happy Diwali more than 200 times. So good to be back in theatre and to be a tiny part of the experience it gives people.

A watercolor sketch of the theater in my sketchbook, with the real building lit up behind it.
Hand-lettered chalkboard labels for the sweets, with a candle and paper marigolds.
The sweets table in the lobby, a row of trays with little labels.

text: A cuckoo-style clock outside the house that tells you the time as you walk by.
Shared margins: a small library of books I love. Borrow one, write in the margins, give it back.
